notes: Reviewed and returned unchanged. Every s### and t### id is partitioned exactly once; no unrepresented or added units are needed, every source token having English in this verse.
s001/s003 follow rule 32 rather than rule 31: no head noun is expressed, so the article keeps only he and the participle keeps that said, headed on said.

The two 'commit adultery' units head on adultery under rule 17's support-verb clause and rule 91's operational test (commit carries no part of the μοιχεύω lexeme, as bear witness carries none of μαρτυρέω). A head on commit is the competing reading and is named in both units; it could rest only on English syntax, which rule 17 forbids.

The English do-support in Do not commit (t005) and dost not commit (t017) is licensed by the negation in English, but rule 9 places an auxiliary with the verb it belongs to, so both ride with their verbs and only not goes to μή/οὐ. That leaves s005, s009 and s013 discontinuous, which rule 15 permits and which absorbs no unrelated token.
s012 οὐ stays aligned: rules 41 and 59 empty a negator only where a negative indefinite follows that can carry the English negation alone, and none stands here.
s018 νόμου is anarthrous, so no article/noun split arises and the whole of of the law is one unit; rule 21's of the analysis applies only where a Greek article is present.
